hosting: romUrl values are same-repo relative paths (relative to classic/coleco/index.html). ROM sources and licenses are documented in ATTRIBUTION.md. NOTE: the gearcoleco core requires a ColecoVision BIOS, which the user must provide — none is ever bundled here.

games.title: 240P TEST SUITE CV
games.desc: Oscar Toledo G. (nanochess) port of Artemio Urbina's 240p Test Suite for ColecoVision — the classic CRT/lag calibration toolkit (PLUGE, color bars, grid, sharpness, monoscope and more), written in assembly.

games.title: RETROPIPE
games.desc: A Pipe Dream clone for TMS9918A-powered computers by Troy Schrapel (visrealm), built with CVBasic. Lay pipe fast, keep the flooz flowing — ColecoVision release v0.2.0.
